value.rationale: The natural symmetric six-coordinate model is an arithmetic form of a distinguished moduli-related quartic. Its zeta function is a complete invariant over every finite extension and detects a genuinely different Frobenius descent than the standard model. The absence of smooth F2 points supplies a structural arithmetic boundary; this is not an arbitrary cutoff or a mere recomputation of the standard zeta.
